status: Local contract/test successor addressing Claude E notes; accepted extension and candidate Bridge bytes unchanged; no upstream implementation or install
producer: Optional OlympusBridge.GetCensusSnapshot extension built inside upstream Bridge.lua namespace
consumer: Future optional Olympus Verify adapter; no generic SavedVariables parser
authorization: Explicit export action and preview before transport; no upstream communication/PR/install in this step
trust: Unsigned client community observations; never establish membership, native rank, Council eligibility, account uniqueness, II-X affiliation, or grant Discord roles
consumerRequirements: Validate all bounds and clocks server-side at receipt, rejecting future snapshots.
No role or affiliation writes from census imports.
Use locally verified host/session authority for any future upload.
Respect upstream opt-outs and stream masks through its Summary and Masked interfaces.
Timestamp/version visible; stale counts distinct from fresh counts.
Avoid naming guilds OlympusII-X from ordinal guesses.
Retain existing trusted roster verification independently.
Feature-detect the optional method; API_VERSION remains 1 and upstream 1.2.3 does not provide this method.
Label receivedAt as this local client's receipt time, not the reporter's clock, and observedAt as this client's export time.
Treat refusal as unavailable census evidence, never an empty or partially valid census; preserve the explicit freshness/counting distinction.
Implement and separately qualify bounded server-side schema, text/array/count/clock validation before any optional upload is enabled. This local export test does not qualify a consumer or server.

composition.required: Append bridge-extension.lua to the exact pinned Bridge.lua source and execute both as one Lua chunk. Do not load it as a separate addon file.
composition.reason: Masked and ns are file-local to Bridge.lua; same-chunk composition preserves its existing stream-mask behavior.

compatibility.missingMethod: Treat the optional census capability as unavailable; do not infer it from API_VERSION 1 and do not parse SavedVariables as a fallback.

malformedRowPolicy: All-or-nothing over every row supplied by Summary: any malformed row, future receipt time, duplicate case-insensitive guild name, sparse/nonarray shape, or exceeded bound refuses the entire snapshot with nil plus a reason. No valid prefix or partial snapshot is exported. Well-formed rows older than seven days are omitted normally; malformed rows are not silently dropped. Upstream Summary can already filter rows before export.

clockSemantics.observedAt: Current local client ns.Now() when the export is requested.
clockSemantics.receivedAt: guilds[].receivedAt copies the local client receipt time g.t; Data.lua stamps r.t = ns.Now(). It is not the reporter clock or authenticated server evidence.
clockSemantics.futureRefusal: A local clock step backward can make an existing receipt future-dated. Refuse the entire snapshot until the local clock/evidence is reviewed; do not clamp, repair or adopt a reporter timestamp.
clockSemantics.boundaries: Inclusive: online fresh through 900 seconds, total counted through 86400 seconds, retained through 604800 seconds.

constantPinning.method: V2 Lua assertions read exports from the actual pinned Data.lua and compare with the copied extension bounds and this contract. Any upstream pin change requires review and rerun before use.

testedSources: Pinned Bridge.lua plus unchanged extension in one chunk
Pinned Data.lua exports and Summary with synthetic records
qualification.codecReason: Codec.lua is absent from the pinned subset. The test supplies only a synthetic Codec.GUILD_CAP; it neither decodes actual reports nor qualifies decode-side bounds. The >1000 export check is defensive.

reviewBasis.scope: Claude reviewed V1. This documentary/test-only successor is Codex work and is not a new Claude signature.
